capabilities: Log status changes, context entries and time per status in task notes
Prompt sign-offs when tasks enter review or at day's end
Auto-stage tasks on timer start or completed checklists
Roll unfinished tasks' scheduled dates to the next day
Run break and deep-work slots that write daily report blocks
disambiguation: Not a standalone task manager; it does nothing unless TaskNotes is installed and only tracks and edits the lifecycle of TaskNotes tasks.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.4.4+). Starts read-only until the vault is allowed in settings, auto-roll is off by default with a dry-run mode, and the plugin uses no network or telemetry. Listed in the directory as not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that works alongside TaskNotes.
problem: TaskNotes tasks have no built-in lifecycle history, sign-off flow, or automatic rollover of unfinished tasks at the end of the day.

relations.evidence: It does nothing unless TaskNotes is installed and enabled.

summary: Task lifecycle tracker for TaskNotes that logs status history and context, prompts sign-offs, auto-rolls unfinished tasks, and reports on break slots.
